verdict.rationale: Gemini's 'Connected Apps' feature explicitly lets users link Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive and other productivity apps so Gemini can search, summarize, and take actions across them (gemini-docs-10, gemini-docs-17, gemini-docs-23, gemini-docs-30), and Deep Research explicitly supports adding personal Gmail/Drive as research sources (gemini-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating cross-app search quality and reliability, and clarity on completeness across all listed connector types (docs note some limitations, e.g. not usable in Google Messages, gemini-docs-33).
